methodology: Official NBK USD/KZT rate. The endpoint serves one date per request and its window rolls forward (nothing before early May 2021 was reachable on 2026-09-01), so this series is accumulated across runs: each run fetches only the dates still missing plus the last two weeks, then merges with what was already processed. Weekends are not requested. The series starts 2021-05-10 rather than at the window edge because 07.05.2021, a public holiday, is served with a substituted rate instead of a no-data response.
